candidate_058.name: bounded active claim-evidence memory with superseded-value archival
candidate_058.mechanism_hypothesis: Maintain a compact active claim-evidence state rather than either aggressively summarizing the recent transcript or replaying the entire history. Bind each active claim/value to source, units, temporal/spatial support, transformation, and unresolved conflicts; when corrected, replace the active value while archiving the superseded value so it cannot silently re-enter later calculations.

primary_evidence.source: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards, arXiv:2608.23525
primary_evidence.design: Controlled context-retention study on one fixed paired manifest with GPT-5.5 at medium reasoning. Only the amount of tool history retained verbatim before summarization changes; the scientific task manifests and harness are held fixed.
primary_evidence.interpretation: The non-monotonic result is direct science-domain evidence that both over-compression and full transcript replay can degrade long-horizon scientific work. The authors' trajectory diagnosis matches the mechanism: aggressive compression severs intermediate values from provenance, while full replay lets rejected hypotheses and superseded numbers reappear. A bounded active claim-evidence state is therefore more plausible than treating the transcript as authority.
primary_evidence.limits: EarthVerse is a controlled package-scoped Earth-science benchmark rather than open-ended discovery. The controlled study uses one backbone and paired subsets; several smaller contrasts elsewhere in the paper have wide intervals. This does not establish the optimal retention length or prove a specific graph implementation.

candidate_058.relation_to_candidate_057: Candidate_057 separates immutable raw authority from lossy summaries at retrieval time. Candidate_058 adds science-domain evidence that the working set itself should contain bounded active claims/evidence while superseded values are archived but not replayed as active state.
candidate_058.status: New mechanism candidate with matched science-domain controlled evidence.

candidate_059.name: evidence-localization-first controller before generic planning
candidate_059.mechanism_hypothesis: Before spending budget on generic high-level planning, localize the source files and source roles/intermediate quantities that can satisfy the current scientific obligations. Keep the plan answer-free and revisable; route subsequent reasoning around identified evidence gaps rather than around a fixed plan generated from an incomplete state.

primary_evidence.source: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards, arXiv:2608.23525
primary_evidence.design: Answer-free oracle study on the same paired tasks and Top-20 semantic-router baseline. Each oracle removes only one information bottleneck while keeping model, budget, tools, and scoring unchanged and never reveals the target answer.
primary_evidence.interpretation: On this controlled scientific benchmark, locating relevant evidence and its roles is a much larger bottleneck than supplying a generic answer-free plan. This supports making evidence localization and claim-evidence obligation mapping first-class controller operations rather than assuming more planning depth will recover missing evidence.
primary_evidence.limits: Oracle information is diagnostic and not a deployable locator; the result does not prove an autonomous locator can achieve the same gain. EarthVerse is bounded and package-scoped.

candidate_059.status: New mechanism candidate with strong paired science-domain bottleneck evidence.

candidate_060.name: revisable semantic tool routing with applicability-aware refusal
candidate_060.mechanism_hypothesis: Expose a small general tool core plus a dynamically selected specialist subset as a revisable prior, rather than the full catalog or a hard precommitted workflow. Every scientific tool should expose applicability conditions and a justified-refusal path so the controller does not force incompatible data into an available method.

primary_evidence.source: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards, arXiv:2608.23525
primary_evidence.design: Controlled tool-catalog/routing and required-scientific-environment studies under GPT-5.5 with fixed paired manifests.
primary_evidence.interpretation: More tools are not monotonically better, and hard workflow commitment can be brittle. A semantic router that narrows the next choice without fixing the entire investigation performs better here. Required specialist use can help when method assumptions fit the evidence, but can substantially hurt when required variables or temporal support are absent, motivating explicit applicability/refusal semantics.
primary_evidence.limits: Tool implementations and EarthVerse package structure are benchmark-specific; exact catalog sizes and domain-tool ranking should not be generalized.

candidate_060.status: New mechanism candidate with paired science-domain routing evidence.

evidence_corrections.memory_evaluation_budget: Beyond Memory Leaderboards shows that apparent memory-system wins can be dominated by retrieval volume: on PAIM Graphiti returns about 2.55-2.6M characters per query; at approximately 30K-character matched budget, Simple RAG 7.25 and Theoria 7.19 are effectively ahead while Graphiti KG output is 5.27. Scientific-memory comparisons must therefore report achieved retrieval volume and modality, not architecture labels alone.
evidence_corrections.memory_evaluation_scope: The same paper uses a fixed synthesis model and mostly single runs per system/budget; small differences should not be promoted as stable architecture effects. It explicitly notes that sequential research-agent memory remains future work.

parallel_frontier_search.matched_mandatory_science_repair: EarthVerse gives controlled evidence that reasoning helps only when it can retrieve, recompute, or correct evidence; fixed-snapshot extra reasoning can sharply hurt. However, it does not isolate a same-model optional-critique versus mandatory-repair arm, so that exact causal frontier remains open.
parallel_frontier_search.fresh_root_restart: Still unproven in autonomous science; archived-state re-anchoring has evidence, but a matched full fresh-root restart versus continued repair experiment remains open.
parallel_frontier_search.memory_frontier: Now prioritize multi-backbone replication of bounded active claim-evidence state versus full replay, explicit stale/contradiction lifecycle tests, and a science-domain comparison of static memory injection versus boundary-aware conditional routing.
